newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to issue T-bills on August 29.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to issue T-bills on August 29.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank will auction three-month, six-month, nine-month and 12-month discount treasury bills on August 29, a central bank official said on Wednesday.
The central bank is not setting the issue volume in advance, the head of the bank's capital markets and exchange department, Vitaly Migashko, told Reuters.

At the last auction of three-month discount T-bills on August 27, the bank sold 735.94 billion karbovanets worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 57.30 percent. The average price was 8.750 million karbovanets.

At the last auction of six-month discount T-bills on August 27, the bank sold 312.78 billion karbovanets worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 59.90 percent. The average price was 7.700 million karbovanets.

At the last auction of nine-month discount T-bills on August 20, the bank sold 770 million karbovanets worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 56.21 percent. The average price was 7.040 million karbovanets.

At the last auction of 12-month discount T-bills on August 16, the bank sold 4.695 trillion karbovanets worth of paper, with an average annualised yield of 56.65 percent. The average price was 6.390 million karbovanets.
